notes.title: Gori Demo Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Wanna fight creepy toys and slice some unicorns as a murder-kitty on a Hoverboard?[/h1]

Gori: Cuddly Carnage is our latest game where we want the player to face ugly, disgusting and cute creatures and then slice them to pieces.

We are super excited to make this game and really want to make it the best we possibly can!
Give the alpha demo a try and add it to your wishlist if you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299690/Gori_Cuddly_Carnage/

Thank you for purchasing and playing our games, we love you guys! // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Version 1.2 live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have patched Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn… And it’s a big one this time!
[list]
 [*]English speech added as an option
 [*]Possibility for black bars to maintain aspect ratio when using other ratios than 16:9
 [*]Improvements in UI
 [*]Environmental improvements for navigational purposes
 [*]Full paus-function during gameplay.
 [*]Puzzle design enhanced
 [*]Huldra AI-behavior altered
 [*]Italian, English and Swedish subs corrected
 [*]Minor event-correction and clarification
 [*]Minor menu updates
[/list]
We hope players will enjoy these updates!

Take care // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Fixes and updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

At the same time as we work on our new project we are still trying to maintain Unforgving. A big thank you to everyone reporting issues and errors and for all the feedback we get! We really appreciate it all!

We recently patched the game with:

- New french subtitling,
- Fixes of minor bugs and issues.

We'll keep you guys posted on all updates on Unforgiving and our new project!

Regards // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Major Update! Updated subs, 日本語字幕あり, gameplayfixes and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’ve been watching as many letsplays and streams as we've possibly can. We’ve also read comments on our disscussionboard and on other announcements at the same time as we’ve listened to feedback through messages everywhere.
This has resulted in a major patch of Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn that’s live now! 

Version 1.1.0 includes:
- Added Japanese subtitling (Five keys available for verified Japanese 
  letsplayers/streamers, first come first serve)
- Fixed german subtitles (We got ripped off twice by our translator and we don’t 
  know any German :( )
- Fixed Russian subtitles
- Major level changes resulting in a much shorter walk in the beginning
- Fixed collision issues
- Made it easier to find the right path after the marsh
- Falling out of the zipline cage no longer occurs

// Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Trading cards, Swedish subs/UI, Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
Trading cards and everything that comes with it like badges, emoticons and a lot more are now live!
We also added:
- Swedish UI and subtitles for those of you who requested it.
- Removed unknown Swedish tradition where unprovoked eyepoking occurs.
- Fixed minor bugs and gameplay issues.

notes.title: First patch, 1.0.7
notes.content:
We have been watching a ton of playthroughs of the game and we’ve been squashing bugs and fixing gameplay problems as fast as we can.

Fixes for version 1.0.7

- Thai subtitles are now working
- Changed some things in the first puzzle in the swamp
- Fixed duplication of inventory items.
- Fixed problem where “ghast” (monsters in the mines) get stuck.
- Removed toggle fullscreen with F11 and alt + enter (it had some issues)
- Shorter transport time on raft and in zipline cage
- Fixed some weird twitching of Lukas
- Fixed sound effects not stopping after troll chase
- General gameplay improvements
